title: Helwit Wintermint Nicotine Pouches 9mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Wintermint Nicotine Pouches feature a refreshing Wintermint flavour with cool menthol and a light herbal twist. Each pouch contains 9mg of nicotine and is made with soft, plant-based materials designed for a comfortable fit under the lip. Helwit Winter offers a refined cooling option for those who enjoy a mint pouch with character. How to Use: Nicotine Pouches PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
